about: A status change (task.sh set / release --to, the Boss app's Move): the issue before, the new status and note, and the issue after. The old status label is swapped for the new one (none when closing; labels sorted), Waiting on / Check after lines are rewritten at the top of the body, done / dropped close the issue as completed / not_planned (state_reason is checked only for a closed result), any open status reopens it.
